To get the best results with your mattress: 
Protect: We highly recommend using a mattress protector to prevent damage to your Endy.
Clean: If you aren't using a protector, you can remove its Breathable Quilted Mattress Cover by the zipper and spot clean with a mild detergent and water. The top half of this cover (the white and grey micro-quilted fabric) is also machine washable in cold water and should be air-dried. Machine drying will shrink the Breathable Quilted Mattress Cover.
